description: jest-image-snapshot 6.5.2 on an image that differs (B23e Phase 2c): `v1` and `v2` share one `customSnapshotIdentifier`; a first run stores v1, then `-t v2` fails with the share and count of differing pixels (one of sixteen) and writes the diff under `__image_snapshots__/__diff_output__/`, hashed with the stored image. The failure reaches Jest's totals (`unmatched`). Two files, one worker.
